My dear [Mr Graves](/person/577)
I am afraid I must not take Second Fiddles though I am much obliged to you for it. We are changing our printing house, and I want to have only matters of necessity on my hands just now.[^1]
[Mr Craik](/person/379) is going to send me a photograph of [Bp Patteson](/person/1155)’s sculpture. I hope we shall have it in the next [edition](/book/102).

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
